remarks: One of a kind end unit in one of the best condo complexes in Norwalk! Beautifully updated, end unit townhouse. 2 Bedroom, 2.5 Bath with lots of privacy & light. Newly painted. Unit has its garage directly across from the front door! Remodeled kitchen with quartz counters & new tile floor. Baths with new quartz countertops. Hardwood floors throughout. Fireplace in living room.  Large Deck off living room with stairs into garden Loads of storage: cabinets, basement, attic, garage. Sunken Living Room with hardwood floors, baseboard heating & fireplace. Each Bedroom has its own private bath. Two large pools in complex plus wading pool. New Tennis/Pickleball courts.
